treaty_name: Convention between Norway and Lithuania for the avoidance of double taxation and the prevention of fiscal evasion with respect to taxes on income and on capital (1993)
eif_quote: Lovdata metadata: "Avtalens ikrafttredelsesdato 30-12-1993" | Art. 30(2): "The Convention shall enter into force thirty days after the date of the later of the notifications referred to in paragraph 1 and its provisions shall have effect in both Contracting States: a. in respect of taxes withheld at source, on income derived on or after 1 January in the calendar year next following the year in which the Convention enters into force;"
source_title: Lovdata Norges traktater (English version), Convention Norway-Lithuania 1993 with Protocol; authentic language(s): Norwegian, Lithuanian and English, equally authentic

rates.quote: a. 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 25 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b. 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
b. 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties in all other cases.

ppt.quote: Notwithstanding any provisions of a Covered Tax Agreement, a benefit under the Covered Tax Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of the Covered Tax Agreement. [MLI Art. 7(1) applies to the Norway-Lithuania Convention (listed by both; no Art. 35(7) reservation by either); WHT effect 2020-01-01 per map.json (Art. 35(1)(a)).]

notes: Art. 12(2)(a): 5% on royalties for the use of industrial, commercial or scientific equipment (not modelled; Protocol para. 6 includes equipment leasing in royalties; Protocol para. 5 excludes drilling-rig payments). Art. 11(3): interest exempt at source when paid to the other State, its subdivisions/statutory bodies, central bank, export-credit institutions (GIEK, Eksportfinans) or on loans guaranteed by them, and on credit sales of merchandise/equipment between unrelated enterprises (not modelled). Art. 12(7): automatic most-favoured-nation clause - if Lithuania later agrees with a then-OECD member a narrower royalty definition, exemption or lower rate, it applies automatically; no official Norwegian notice of a triggered reduction was located, so the treaty rates are recorded unchanged. MLI Art. 8 (365-day holding) does not apply: Lithuania reserved the entirety of Art. 8 under Art. 8(3)(a). Art. 10(2) final paragraph: competent authorities may settle the mode of application.
